comparison: Ordered Spike and RTL GPR state-change updates; the comparator skips updates that do not change its tracked register state and does not compare every retired instruction, PC, opcode, or memory update.

debug_port_check.scope: Combinational external-port observations for GPR x0/x13/x31 and CSR mstatus/mtvec/dmst reads and writes with no ordinary valid instruction. Compare synthesized instruction, decode valid, debug valid, write-data selection, and the dmst write fence. Type-2 debug reads and writes at the selected DCCM base must leave decode valid, debug valid, write-data selection, and the fence inactive with no valid fetch. An idle-debug case checks ordinary instruction forwarding and inactive debug outputs.
